scheme_name: UK solid radioactive waste categories by activity concentration: LLW, VLLW (high volume) and above-LLW
scheme_version: UK Strategy for the Management of Solid Low Level Waste from the Nuclear Industry, February 2016; definitions unchanged from the 2007 Defra/DTI policy

sources.title: UK Strategy for the Management of Solid Low Level Waste from the Nuclear Industry (DECC, February 2016)
Policy for the Long Term Management of Solid Low Level Radioactive Waste in the United Kingdom (Defra, DTI and the Devolved Administrations, 26 March 2007)

llw.quote: radioactive waste having a radioactive content not exceeding four gigabecquerels per tonne (GBq/te) of alpha or 12 GBq/te of beta/gamma radioactivity

vllw_high_volume.quote: Radioactive waste with maximum concentrations of four megabecquerels per tonne (MBq/te) of total
vllw_high_volume.tritium_quote: the concentration limit for tritium is 40MBq/te

vllw_low_volume.quote: each 0.1m 3 of waste containing less than 400 kilobecquerels (kBq) of total
vllw_low_volume.reason: the limits are per 0.1 m3 of waste and per single item; an inventory of one component does not say how the waste is packaged or itemised

hlw.reason: the 2007 policy defines HLW by whether heat must be taken into account in the design of storage or disposal facilities, with no number; FARIS encodes no heat criterion
